<Heading
  as={"h1"}
  className={"openapi__heading"}
  children={"Confirm one scan of an each or case GTIN against a PICK task"}
>
</Heading>

<MethodEndpoint
  method={"post"}
  path={"/tasks/{id}/scans"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



The station holding the claim on a PICK task scans a GTIN (ADR 0054). The GTIN is resolved against the local copy of product-master's pack levels (no synchronous call): it must identify the task's SKU and, for a task planned in eaches, an EACH level; for a task planned in cases, a CASE level. `count` packs are added (default 1) and the answer reports the eaches confirmed so far. Quantities are always in eaches; `POST /tasks/{id}/completions` and `TaskCompleted` are unchanged. A rejected scan changes nothing.

**Idempotent per `Idempotency-Key` (ADR-0055).** Send a fresh `Idempotency-Key` for each physical scan and reuse it only when retrying that scan after a lost response. A retry with the same key and the same body on the same path replays the stored answer verbatim (same status and body, including a cached 4xx) and does not count the scan again; two scans with different keys both count. Reusing a key with a different body or on another task is `409 idempotency-key-reused`; omitting the header is `400 idempotency-key-required`.
